title: 토지개발 등기규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Contents and Method of Providing Application Information)
(1) Applications for cancellation of registration concerning former land shall be filed collectively for all parcels of land by means of a single set of application information, which shall state to the registry office that the application for registration is made due to implementation of a land development project.
(2) Paragraph (1) shall apply mutatis mutandis to applications for preservation of ownership registration concerning newly developed land.
(3) Registrations falling under Article 2 (2) 1 or 2 shall be applied for collectively by means of a single set of application information together with the registration under paragraph (2).
(4) Registrations falling under Article 2 (2) 3 or 4 shall be applied for by means of separate application information following the application under paragraph (2); where multiple such registrations exist, separate application information shall be provided for each in the order recorded in the former land registration records. In such cases, the registration completion information of the person obligated to register need not be provided to the registry office as part of the application information.
(5) Where registration of superficies, a right to lease on a deposit basis, a leasehold right, or an easement over servient land continues to exist over part of the newly developed land, information concerning the portion over which the relevant right continues shall be provided to the registry office as part of the application information.
